stories.title: LeBron fires up sellout Philly crowd with monster slam in home debut
stories.summary: LeBron James gave a sellout crowd a glimpse of his "connection" with new teammate Tyrese Maxey when he threw down an alley-oop jam in his Sixers home debut.

stories.title: ESPN secures 'handshake agreement' to broadcast 24-team CFP, sources say
stories.summary: The CFP reached a "handshake agreement" with ESPN to broadcast a 24-team playoff beginning in the 2027 season, sources told ESPN on Friday, and though there is work to be done on paper, this is a significant step closer to doubling the postseason field.

stories.title: Spurs going with 3-guard starting lineup in season opener vs. Thunder
stories.summary: The Spurs will start guards De'Aaron Fox, Stephon Castle and Dylan Harper alongside Devin Vassell and Victor Wembanyama when they face the Thunder in Tuesday's season opener.

stories.title: Rain pushes Rays-Guardians ALCS Game 4 to Saturday; Sunday off-day now Game 5
stories.summary: Game 4 of the ALCS was postponed late Friday night due to rain, creating an unusual set of circumstances for the Guardians and Rays.

stories.title: Packers RB Jacobs eligible to return next week amid ongoing probe
stories.summary: Packers RB Josh Jacobs will be removed from the commissioner exempt list Monday, the league announced, making him eligible to practice and play next week.
